Planner: Hopeful handover, any word from our senior planner
Coordinator: The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the file in order and crews have the same reference notes.
Planner: <<FACT F091>> Please keep the booking packet moving and log only the confirmed details.
Coordinator: I have checked the pet guidance and the notes stay clear for the next desk.
Handler: Hazel is listed with the correct carrier note and the passenger file is readable.
Planner: The record also needs a clean note on routing, so the station team can follow it.
Coordinator: <<FACT F102>> I have flagged the incident log for review and kept the wording plain.
Planner: Good, keep the language neutral and avoid loose remarks in the handover.
Coordinator: I will update the companion animal checklist and preserve the same order for crew use.
Planner: That should be enough for the shift file, and the archive remains easy to read.
